items.originalTitle: Toto Wolff explains George Russell's media absence after Mexican GP disappointment
items.summaryEn: Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff defended George Russell's decision to skip media duties after a disappointing Mexican Grand Prix, describing it as a "catastrophic moment" for Russell.
detailZh: 沃尔夫解释拉塞尔在墨西哥大奖赛表现令人失望后缺席媒体采访的原因
梅赛德斯车队领队沃尔夫为拉塞尔在墨西哥大奖赛表现令人失望后缺席媒体采访的决定作出辩护
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭车队的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
梅赛德斯一级方程式车队领队兼首席执行官托托·沃尔夫将墨西哥大奖赛描述为乔治·拉塞尔的“灾难性时刻”。
这位英国车手在排位赛中仅落后法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿0.009秒，正赛从第二位发车，但起步后立即丢失位置。随后他又因第一圈与红牛的伊萨克·哈贾尔发生碰撞而被罚10秒。
拉塞尔最终获得第六名，而红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘夺冠。荷兰人与汉密尔顿以及拉塞尔的队友基米·安东内利一同登上领奖台。第三名的成绩足以让这位意大利人加冕2026年世界冠军。拉塞尔向队友表示祝贺，但随后缺席了赛后媒体职责，导致梅赛德斯被罚款5000欧元。
当被问及这是拉塞尔的决定还是车队的决定时，沃尔夫对媒体表示：“我在赛后于国际汽联称重区看到了乔治，显然他对当时的情况感到非常沮丧。去看望基米是体育精神的绝佳体现。”
我认识乔治很久了，我知道对一名运动员来说，这……他正经历一段艰难时期，但当初也是他负责把这位年轻人带进这支车队的。
所以我见了他，对一名赛车手来说，这是灾难性的时刻。也许今天的比赛多少是他本赛季的缩影。这本来是一场他该赢的比赛。
沃尔夫补充说，车队在比赛起步时的能量输出问题“让拉塞尔失望了”。
“我们车上有速度，却在第一段直道让他失望了。能量输出没有达到我们预期的水平，”车队领队继续说道。
“我现在非常支持他。我也曾身处非常难以应对的处境。他不做媒体工作或离开赛道是完全可以理解的。他要是留下来反而会让我惊讶。这绝对值得尊敬。”
拉塞尔仍在争夺年度亚军。在墨西哥站获得第六名后，他在积分榜上从第二跌至第四。目前第二到第五之间相差16分。
detailEn: Toto Wolff explains George Russell's media absence after Mexican GP disappointment
Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff defended George Russell's decision to skip media duties after a disappointing Mexican Grand Prix
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
Mercedes Formula 1 team principal and CEO Toto Wolff described the Mexican Grand Prix as a "catastrophic moment" for George Russell.

The Briton started second on the grid after qualifying just 0.009 seconds behind Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton, but immediately lost ground. He was then also given a 10-second penalty for a first-lap collision with Red Bull's Isack Hadjar.

Russell ultimately finished sixth while Red Bull's Max Verstappen won. The Dutchman was joined on the podium by Hamilton and Russell's team-mate Kimi Antonelli. The third-place finish was enough to crown the Italian 2026 world champion. Russell congratulated his team-mate but subsequently missed his post-race media duties, resulting in a €5000 for Mercedes.

Asked whether that had been Russell's decision or the team's, Wolff told the media: "I saw George after the race on the FIA scales, and obviously he's distraught about the situation. It was a great show of sportsmanship to go and see Kimi.
"I have known George for such a long time, and I know for a sportsperson, this is ... He's going through a hard time, but he was also responsible for getting the young man into this team.
"So I saw him, and for a racing driver, this is a catastrophic moment. Maybe today the race was a little bit of a picture of his season. This was a race for him to win."
Wolff added that the team 'let Russell down' with the energy delivery issues at the race start.
"We had the pace in the car and we let him down on the first straight. The energy delivery is not what we thought it should be," the team chief continued.

"I'm very much with him at the moment. I've been in situations where it's very difficult to cope. Him not doing the media work or leaving the track is absolutely understandable. Him staying would have actually surprised me. That's absolutely honourable."

Russell is still in the fight for second in the championship. After finishing sixth in Mexico, he dropped from second to fourth in the standings. There are currently 16 points separating second and fifth.

If Mercedes outscore Ferrari by three points, or more, they will be world champions.

There are several ways they can do this but the most simple scenarios that will see Mercedes win the Constructors' Championship involve either Antonelli or Russell winning the race, with the other driver finishing fourth or better.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯盛赞安东内利：他让所有人显得可笑
items.summaryZh: 2026年F1新科世界冠军安东内利在墨西哥大奖赛以第三名完赛加冕，卫冕冠军诺里斯盛赞他让所有人显得可笑，并认为他完全配得上这份成功。
items.originalTitle: New F1 champion Antonelli 'made everyone look silly'
items.summaryEn: New 2026 Formula 1 world champion Kimi Antonelli clinched the title by finishing third at the Mexican Grand Prix, with outgoing champion Lando Norris saying the Italian made everyone else look silly and fully deserves his success.
detailZh: 据即将卸任的世界冠军兰多·诺里斯所说，2026年F1新科世界冠军基米·安东内利“让所有人显得可笑”。
安东内利在墨西哥大奖赛以第三名完赛，从而成为2026年世界冠军，他的夺冠庆祝画面在车手们进行赛后媒体采访的地点旁的屏幕上播放。
他的F1对手们纷纷送上赞誉，并对他今年所取得的成就表达了真诚的欣赏。
“他所做到的，令人难以置信；他让所有人震惊。我希望每个人都给予他今年成就足够的认可，”诺里斯说。
“他让其他所有人都显得很愚蠢。他开得那么好，而且他能与赛车完美契合。他努力去理解如何驾驶这辆赛车，并且比任何人都更好地发挥了它的潜力。他配得上每一份成功。他配得上他现在所做的这些时刻和庆祝。”
“更令人印象深刻的是，这仅仅是他参加一级方程式的第二个赛季。他才20岁。这太不可思议了。我为他感到非常高兴。我很高兴看到我的一号车手位置转移给他，因为他配得上。从某种意义上说，我很高兴看到它易主。”
诺里斯补充道：“他有一个非常强大的队友[乔治·拉塞尔]，但他从头到尾都击败了他，整个赛季都是如此。”
“[你可以]数数他本赛季犯了多少错误——老实说，我觉得你甚至用一只手[五根手指]都数不完。他从发车区后方起步。他从前方获胜。他做了他需要做的一切。他每一场比赛都在那里。这是本赛季其他任何车手都无法说自己做到的事情。”
“他的稳定性，他的表现。他把所有人都打败了。把和他开同一辆车的人也打败了。这很难做到。这非常令人印象深刻。”
完美的领奖台？
弗朗哥·科拉平托正在回顾自己的比赛时，安东内利正站在领奖台上，身旁是他在梅赛德斯取代的车手刘易斯·汉密尔顿，以及他长期以来被比较的对象马克斯·维斯塔潘。
“他就在那里，在刘易斯和马克斯之间，”科拉平托说。“没有比这更好的了——世界冠军在F1近年两位最佳冠军之间。”
“他配得上这个冠军；他非常年轻，所以需要享受这一刻。这是我们所有人的梦想，他今年所经历的一切正是如此。
“速度方面，我们早就知道他有这个能力，但我认为他今年展现出的稳定性——赢下比赛、登上领奖台、拿到积分并且不犯错误——令人印象极其深刻。
“几乎从赛季初到赛季末都背负着积分榜第一的重担，哇，他处理得非常好。
“为他感到非常高兴，他是世界冠军，所以他是当之无愧的冠军。”
汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘都迅速向安东内利致敬，在围场封闭区拥抱了他，维斯塔潘说他“为他感到非常骄傲”，而汉密尔顿说他“非常感激能在这场比赛中见证”F1史上最年轻冠军的“相当非凡”加冕。
安东内利已经赢下九场比赛，今年在他完赛的大奖赛中仅有一次未能登上领奖台。
“他的稳定性，”当《The Race》问及安东内利本赛季最令人印象深刻的部分时，加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托说道。
“我在F2和F3为冠军而战过，我知道你在争夺时有多紧张，但想象一下在F1锦标赛中与拉塞尔、马克斯、刘易斯以及所有这些世界冠军争夺。那么多经验，而这家伙没有崩溃。”
“他总是保持稳定，砰，位居榜首。我的意思是，他[只]有一两场糟糕的比赛，你可以说他没有速度或者撞车了。
“所以，他的表现令人印象深刻，我希望未来能和他一起争夺冠军，因为那将是一个美好的故事，一个我从10岁、11岁就认识的人，进入F1，现在成为冠军。我正在努力达到那个[目标]，希望有一天能实现。”
安东内利在第二个赛季就拥有一辆有争冠实力的赛车，这令人羡慕——他的对手们会渴望如此——但他们中没有人怀疑安东内利已经最大化了这个机会。
“完全应得的，”卡洛斯·塞恩斯说。“老实说，他度过了一个非常非常好的年份。他知道如何在F1的第二个赛季最大化成为世界冠军的机会。”
“我们很多人都会希望在进入一级方程式的头几年就拥有如此有竞争力的赛车，而他恰好拥有这样的赛车。他获得了赢得世界冠军的机会，而在机会降临的那一年，他把一切都发挥到了极致。
“他在上半年表现完美，占据统治地位，随后在下半年控制住了局面，这正是世界冠军必须做到的，我认为他真的做得非常出色。”
塞恩斯的威廉姆斯队友阿尔本开玩笑说：“进入这一年时，我不确定他的夺冠赔率是多少”，并补充道：“这真的令人印象深刻。
“还有他的心态。至少从外界来看，他显得非常放松。
“我在排位赛中听到一些评论，说他有点紧张。除了墨西哥站的排位赛之外，他的表现一直很好。”
“要说的话，他的正赛速度确实非常令人印象深刻。这正是今年他与其他车手拉开差距的地方。”
“当然，这大概也有一部分是赛车的原因，但看到他的表现确实非常令人印象深刻。”
detailEn: Formula 1’s new world champion Kimi Antonelli has “made everyone look silly” in 2026, according to outgoing champion Lando Norris.

Antonelli became the 2026 champion by finishing third in the Mexican Grand Prix and his title celebrations were playing out on screens next to where drivers were conducting their post-race media debriefs.
There was plenty of praise from his F1 rivals and genuine appreciation for what he’s been able to achieve this year.
“Unbelievable, what he’s done; he’s blown everyone away. I hope everyone gives him enough credit for what he’s achieved this year,” Norris said.

“He’s made everyone else look silly. He’s driven that well, and he’s been able to click with his car. He’s worked hard to understand how to drive this car, and he’s exploited it better than anyone else. He deserves every single bit of success. He deserves these moments he’s doing now and celebrating.

“It’s even more impressive that it’s only his second season in Formula 1. He’s 20 years old. It’s incredible. I’m very happy for him. I’m very happy to see my number one go over to him, because he deserves it. I’m, in a way, happy to see it go.”
Norris added: “He has a very strong team-mate [George Russell], but he’s beaten him the whole time, the whole season.

“[You can] count how many mistakes he’s made this season - I don’t even think you could put it on [all five fingers of] one hand, honestly. He’s come from the back of the grid. He’s won from the front. He’s done everything he needs to do. He’s been there every single race. That’s something that no other driver can say they’ve done this season.
“His consistency, his performance. He’s smashed everyone. Smashed the guy in the same car as him. That’s difficult to do. That’s been very impressive.”
The perfect podium?

Franco Colapinto was debriefing his race when Antonelli was standing on the podium alongside the driver he replaced at Mercedes, Lewis Hamilton, and the driver he’s long been compared to, Max Verstappen.
“There he is, between Lewis and Max,” Colapinto said. “It can’t get any better than that - the world champion between the two best champions in the last years of F1.
“He deserves it; he’s extremely young, so he needs to enjoy it. It’s the dream of all of us, what he had this year.

“The speed, we all knew that he had it, but I think the consistency he showed this year, winning the races, being on the podium and scoring the points and not making mistakes, has been extremely impressive.
“To have that weight on your shoulders of being P1 in the championship for so long, from almost the start to the end - it’s wow, [he dealt with it] so very well.
“Very happy for him and he’s a world champion, so he’s a deserved champion.”

Hamilton and Verstappen were both quick to pay tribute to Antonelli, embracing him in parc ferme, with Verstappen saying he was “very proud of him” while Hamilton said he was “so grateful to be in the race to witness” the “pretty phenomenal” crowning of F1’s youngest-ever champion.
Antonelli has won nine races and has only been off the podium in one grand prix he’s finished this year.
“His consistency,” Gabriel Bortoleto said when The Race asked what’s been the most impressive part of Antonelli’s season.

“I fought for championships in F2 and F3, and I know how nervous you are when you are fighting, but imagine fighting for a Formula 1 championship against Russell, Max, Lewis, all these world champions. So much experience, and the guy didn’t break.
“He was always there, consistent, boom, on top. I mean, he [only] had one or two bad races where you can say he was out of pace or he crashed.

“So, impressive job from him and I hope to be fighting for titles with him in the future because that would be a beautiful story, a guy I’ve known since I was, like, 10 years old, 11 years old, to F1 and now he’s champion. I’m trying to reach that [goal] so hopefully one day.”

Antonelli’s been in an enviable position of having a title-challenging car in his second season - his rivals would relish that - but there’s zero doubt among them that Antonelli has maximised the opportunity.
“Completely deserved,” Carlos Sainz said. “Honestly, he's done a really, really good year. He's known how to maximise his chance of becoming world champion in his second year in Formula 1.

“A lot of us would have wished to have such a competitive car in our first years in Formula 1, and he had exactly that. He was given the opportunity to win a championship, and the year that it was given it to him, he maximised everything.
“He did a perfect first half of the year, dominated and then controlled the second part of the year, which is what a world champion has to do, and I think he did it really, really well.”
Sainz's Williams team-mate Alex Albon joked that “coming into the year, I'm not sure what his betting odds were”, adding: “It's really impressive.
“Also his mentality. It seemed, at least from the outside, that he looked very relaxed.
“I heard some comments in qualifying that he was a bit tense. Apart from [Mexico] qualifying, he's been good.
“If anything, his race pace has been really impressive. That's what's separated him from the rest of the grid this year.
“Of course, it's probably partly car as well, but he's been really impressive to see.”

items.originalTitle: Mercedes fined for George Russell skipping F1 Mexico GP media duties
detailZh: 梅赛德斯车队因乔治·拉塞尔未能出席墨西哥大奖赛赛后媒体活动而被罚款5000欧元。
拉塞尔在周日比赛中从第二位发车，但由于电池问题在一圈后下降了四位，最终排名第六。
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯。
梅赛德斯车队在墨西哥大奖赛之后因乔治·拉塞尔未能履行赛后媒体职责而被罚款5000欧元。
梅赛德斯车手在阿特奥多罗·赫尔曼诺斯·罗德里格斯赛道完成了第六名的成绩，尽管他在周日的比赛中从第二位起步，但由于第一圈电池性能不佳，下降了四个位置。
拉塞尔也因为与伊萨克·哈达尔在第六弯道相撞而受到了10秒的处罚，这导致第六名成为了他当天能期望的最佳成绩，而他的队友基米·安东内利成为了世界冠军。
“赛会官员从车队代表那里得知，该车手在赛后没有履行媒体承诺而离开了赛道，”FIA的报告读道。
“考虑到赛会官员可以继续对未出席听证会的情况作出决定，对参赛者处以5000欧元的罚款。”
梅赛德斯违反了规则B10.1.4e，裁判表示“车手未能出席听证会，车队代表通过电话提供了证据”
查尔斯·勒克莱尔、法拉利、兰多·诺里斯、麦克拉伦、乔治·罗素、梅赛德斯
但后来透露，银箭车队经理托托·沃尔夫已经允许罗素在对于赛季冠军热门来说艰难的一天提前离开赛道
“我在FIA称重台上看到了乔治，很明显他对这种情况感到非常沮丧，”沃尔夫说。
“去看基米真是太有体育精神了。我认识乔治已经很长时间了。
“他现在正经历一段艰难的时光，但他也负责将这位年轻人引入这个车队。所以我去看了他，对于一个赛车手来说，这是一个灾难性的时刻。"
“也许这场比赛反映了他整个赛季的情况。这场比赛对他来说是一次胜利的机会。我们车上有速度，但我们让他第一次直道上失望了。"
“能量的输出并不是我们想象中的样子。我现在非常支持他。我经历过非常难以应对的情况。"
“他不做媒体工作或者离开赛道是完全可以理解的。他留下来实际上会让我感到惊讶。这是绝对的荣幸。”
detailEn: Mercedes fined for George Russell skipping F1 Mexico GP media duties
Russell left the track early on Sunday just as his Mercedes team-mate became world champion
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes
Mercedes was fined €5,000 following the Mexico Grand Prix after George Russell failed to attend his post-race Formula 1 media commitments.
The Mercedes driver finished sixth at Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez despite starting Sunday’s race in second, having dropped four positions on lap one due to a poor battery.
Russell also suffered a 10s penalty for colliding into Isack Hadjar at Turn 6, causing sixth to be the best he could hope for on the day that team-mate Kimi Antonelli became world champion.
“The stewards heard from the team representative that the driver had left the circuit without attending the post race media commitments,” read the FIA report.
“Noting that the stewards can proceed to make a determination in the case of a non attendance at a hearing, a penalty of €5,000 is imposed on the competitor.”
Mercedes was in breach of Article B10.1.4e of the regulations with stewards stating that “the driver failed to attend the hearing and the team representative gave evidence via telephone”.
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lando Norris, McLaren, George Russell, Mercedes
But it later emerged that Silver Arrows boss Toto Wolff had given Russell permission to leave the track early on what was a bruising day for the pre-season title favourite.
“I saw George after the race on the FIA scales and obviously he’s distraught about the situation,” said Wolff.
“It was a great show of sportsmanship to go and see Kimi. I have known George for such a long time.
“He's going through a hard time, but he was also responsible in getting the young man into this team. So I saw him, and for a racing driver this is a catastrophic moment.
“Maybe the race was a little bit a picture of his season. This was a race for him to win. We had the pace in the car and we let him down on the first straight.
“The energy delivery is not what we thought it should be. I'm very much with him at the moment. I've been in situations where it's very difficult to cope.
“Him not doing the media work or leaving the track is absolutely understandable. Him staying would have actually surprised me. That's absolutely honoured.”

items.originalTitle: Lewis Hamilton slams Charles Leclerc for "do or die" attitude after Mexico GP clash
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton criticised his team-mate Charles Leclerc for his "do or die" attitude after Ferrari lost a straightforward victory at the Formula 1 Mexico Grand Prix.
detailZh: 汉密尔顿批评勒克莱尔墨西哥站“拼命”态度
法拉利在周日墨西哥大奖赛首圈两位车手之间的混乱后错失胜利
汉密尔顿批评队友勒克莱尔在F1墨西哥大奖赛上采取“拼命”态度，法拉利因此错失一场本可轻松拿下的胜利。
这位七届世界冠军在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道从杆位起步，勒克莱尔排在第三位；当乔治·拉塞尔在1号弯失去势头时，勒克莱尔升至第二位。
就在那里，这位摩纳哥车手在外线向汉密尔顿发起进攻，希望能在2号弯内线完成超越，但他却碾过了路肩，仍留在第二位。
但事情还在继续，勒克莱尔在4号弯外侧再次向队友发起动作，然而空间迅速消失，他采取规避动作切过5号弯，从而取得领先。
汉密尔顿随后被马克斯·维斯塔潘超越，后者因勒克莱尔在第一圈混乱中受罚五秒而升至第一，最终这位红牛车手获胜。
这位英国车手最终获得第二，排在新科世界冠军基米·安东内利之前，而勒克莱尔位列第四，这意味着法拉利在2026赛季仍只有两场胜利。
夏尔·勒克莱尔，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
愤怒的汉密尔顿表示：“我在梅赛德斯的时候，看过也见证过查尔斯和卡洛斯（塞恩斯）在好几场比赛里来回缠斗，他们争得太凶，结果领先的那个人直接跑远了，而他们本来是有速度去赢的。
“但这种事发生在争第四、第五的时候是一回事，发生在争第一、第二、结果把胜利丢掉的时候就是另一回事了。这很严重。
“这家伙28岁了，所以我不觉得这是年龄的问题。我觉得这是心态的问题。”
“这就像是‘要么赢要么死。要么我赢，要么我们谁都别赢’，不该是这样的。应该是我们拿到一二名。”
周日是勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿近来一系列激烈时刻中的最新一幕，最早始于赞德沃特，当时这位英国车手被挡住，并批评了车队指令的缺失。
随后在蒙扎的下一场比赛中，汉密尔顿在2号弯被逼上砾石区后丢失位置，勒克莱尔为此承担责任，因此这位英国车手认为需要“严肃的谈话”。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利，马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯
但他不确定这能带来多大改变，而在周日墨西哥站之后，勒克莱尔告诉天空体育：“确实存在差距，当你为胜利而战时，我永远会全力以赴。”
“我不知道现在需要发生什么，也不知道回去后我们该如何讨论这些事情，”汉密尔顿说道。
“我不太确定自己想如何参与其中。当然，今天充满了挫败感。我很高兴，因为这家伙刚刚赢得了冠军，所以我真的很矛盾，因为一方面我很高兴，另一方面我真的很恼火。
“我们丢掉了宝贵的积分，而我们作为一支车队付出了巨大的努力。今天我们本可以轻松实现一二名完赛。真的，我们具备做到这一点的速度。”
“我们进入4号弯时排在第一和第二。如果我们只是守住位置，我认为比赛中任何事都可能发生。但当你的队友与你作对，然后你就那样丢掉了位置，这确实很难受。
“所以，我们会在私下再谈这件事，多说也没什么意义。我们没有交战规则，至于这是否会改变夏尔那边的做法，我不知道。
夏尔·勒克莱尔，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
“我们得把这个问题弄清楚，但肯定需要做出改变。”
汉密尔顿的这番话是考虑到马拉内罗的员工而说的，因为车队又一年无缘世界冠军，目前落后已锁定冠军的梅赛德斯126分。
“弗雷德已经尽力了，”汉密尔顿谈到车队领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔时说。“我觉得弗雷德在赛前来找过我谈话，我觉得他当时很紧张。
“他只是希望我们……当然，他希望这两位车手都表现出色。从我这边来说，如果我从后面追赶、承担了所有风险，最终导致整个车队失利，那我觉得我需要做出一些交代，因为这会影响很多人。
“但反过来，当时是我领先，那完全没有必要。我觉得我们本可以轻松地，就像我说的，今天拿到一二名，这对车队、对工厂里所有为带来这些升级而辛勤工作的人来说，都会是巨大的成就。
“我真的不知道会做些什么，因为到目前为止其实什么都没做。所以，是的，我们走着瞧吧。”
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton slams Charles Leclerc for "do or die" attitude after Mexico GP clash
Ferrari lost victory in Sunday's Mexico GP following a lap one fiasco between its two F1 drivers
Lewis Hamilton has criticised team-mate Charles Leclerc for his “do or die” attitude after Ferrari lost a straightforward victory at the Formula 1 Mexico Grand Prix.
The seven-time world champion started on pole at Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez with Leclerc third, but he rose to second when George Russell lost momentum into Turn 1.
It was there that the Monegasque attacked Hamilton on the outside with the hope of completing it down the inside of Turn 2, but he instead ran over that kerb and remained second.
But it continued as Leclerc again made a move on his team-mate at the outside of Turn 4, yet space quickly disappeared and he took evasive action by cutting Turn 5 to gain the lead.
Hamilton was consequently overtaken by Max Verstappen, who subsequently took first due to Leclerc’s five-second penalty for the lap one fiasco, leading to the Red Bull driver winning.
The Briton ultimately finished second ahead of new world champion Kimi Antonelli, while Leclerc took fourth, meaning Ferrari remained on just two wins across the 2026 campaign.
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari

A furious Hamilton said: “When I was at Mercedes, I watched and witnessed the back and forth between Charles and Carlos [Sainz] several races, where they were battling so much that the person ahead just pulled away, and they had the pace to actually win.
“But it is one thing when that's happening in fourth and fifth, as opposed to first and second, and you lose the win. That's significant.
“The guy is 28 years old, so I don't think it's an age thing. I think it's a mentality thing.
“It's like, ‘Do or die. Either I win or none of us do’, and it shouldn't be that. It should be us getting that one-two.”
Sunday was the latest in a series of heated moments between Leclerc and Hamilton recently, starting with Zandvoort where the Briton was held up and criticised the lack of team orders.
Then the following race at Monza, Hamilton lost positions after being forced onto the gravel at Turn 2, which Leclerc took responsibility for, so the Briton reckons “serious talks” are needed.
Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes
But he’s unsure how much of a difference that will make and after Mexico on Sunday, Leclerc told Sky Sports that “there was a gap and when you are fighting for a win, I will always go for it”.
“I don't know what needs to happen now, how we discuss things when we go back,” said Hamilton.

“I'm not quite sure how I want to engage in that. Of course, the frustrations are today. I'm happy because this guy just won the championship, so I'm really torn because, on one side, I'm happy, and on the other side, I'm really pissed.
“We lost valuable points, and we, as a team, worked so hard. We could have easily had a one-two today. Really, we had the pace to do so.

“We're going into Turn 4 first and second. If we just hold position, I think anything can happen in the race. But when your team-mate works against you and then you lose positions like that, it's definitely tough.

“So, we'll just talk about it offline, and it's not really worth saying too much more. We don't have rules of engagement, and whether or not that will change anything from Charles' side, I don't know.
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari
“We've just got to figure it out, but something needs to change for sure.”
Hamilton’s comments were made with the staff at Maranello in mind amid it going yet another year without a world title, as it trails champion-elect Mercedes by 126 points.
“Fred's doing his best,” said Hamilton of team boss Fred Vasseur. “I think Fred came and spoke to me before the race, and I think he was nervous.

“He just wanted us... Of course, he wants these two drivers to do well. From my side, if I'm coming from behind and I'm taking all the risk and it ends up that we lose as a team, then I think I have some answering to do, because it impacts a lot of people.

“But the other way around, I'm in the lead, and it was just unnecessary. I think we could have easily, as I said, had that one-two today, which would have been huge for the team and for everyone back at the factory who's worked so hard to bring us these upgrades.
“I don't really know what will be done because up until now nothing really has been done. So, yeah, we'll see.”

items.titleZh: Edd Straw的2026年墨西哥大奖赛车手排名
items.summaryZh: Edd Straw在新的车手排名体系中分析了每位车手在墨西哥大奖赛中的表现，讨论了谁进入了S级，谁的失误影响了排名。
items.originalTitle: Edd Straw's F1 2026 Mexican Grand Prix tier list driver rankings
detailZh: 这是Edd Straw新一级别一级方程式赛车手排名格式的第二周，他仔细分析了每位车手在墨西哥大奖赛中的个人表现。
考虑到在墨西哥城周末期间没有人完美无缺，谁最终进入了备受瞩目的S级别？而谁的错误导致了他们的排名下降？
通常，您可以通过在《The Race Members' Club》这篇帖子下评论来询问Edd的排名，并尝试使用我们方便的视觉工具来编制自己的墨西哥大奖赛级别列表！
维斯塔潘以他一贯的敏锐和出色表现参赛，展现出强大的速度和出色的起跑和保持汉密尔顿在后面的决策。除此之外，他还对红牛在艰难的周五之后恢复状态起到了关键作用。
在许多情况下，那次锁死导致他上一圈资格赛被毁，本可能让他失去在这个等级的位置，但交通状况的缓解因素救了他——尽管周五与利亚姆·劳森的混乱导致的单圈处罚也是一个小小的负面因素，在其他情况下可能会让他降到更低等级。
梶谷隆太的独特情况意味着他必须根据他接管埃斯蒂班·奥康的位置后所做的工作来评判，通常这些标准对他来说已经很宽容了。他在最后一圈Q1的中间部分遇到了亚历克斯·阿隆索的混乱气流，差点进入Q2，这意味着与贝尔曼的差距被夸大了。然后他进行了一场充满斗志的比赛，在最后阶段超越了威廉姆斯的两名车手，在处罚后赢得了应得的积分。
利亚姆·劳森从挫折中恢复过来，赢得了积分。他从维修区起步，尽管红旗的时间对他不利，但他稳步前进，从起跑线上的第15位冲刺到最终在处罚后赢得了中游胜利。
对于刘易斯·汉密尔顿来说，这是一个强劲的周末，除了他在4号弯的失误之外，当时两名车手都刹车太晚，无法完成转弯。如果他避免了那次失误，他可能会与维斯塔潘交换位置。这也是他自2023年以来的第一个 pole position，而且做得非常出色。
虽然塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯在维修区因超速（0.2km/h）被罚了五秒，但车队把这归咎于传感器问题。尽管佩雷斯对资格赛因设置未到位而有些失望，但在第一节的比赛中他表现出色，先是因轮子问题失去了时间，后来又因后来的罚分而落后。
奥利·比尔曼在练习中不得不更换为旧的ADUO1规格法拉利引擎，这给他的周末带来了打击。尽管如此，他的速度很快，但由于超车限制违规，他未能最大化资格赛的表现。他在比赛中驾驶得相当不错，直到被尼科·胡肯伯格从后面撞到，这不是他的错。在正常情况下，他本可以比队友排名更高，但这个排名反映了平川不寻常的情况。
基米·安东内利赢得了世界冠军，但在资格赛中的健康和速度都不佳，无法与乔治·拉塞尔相匹配。他驾驶得干净利落，跑得很长，只在比赛因红旗而暂停前进站，并有权在领奖台上庆祝他的冠军。
加布里埃尔·博尔特洛托可能是最快的奥迪车手，但在FP1中缺席，然后在FP2和FP3中都出现问题，限制了他仅能在资格赛之前进行三圈飞驰。然后他跑出了第六快的Q1圈，并且在比赛中对设置“有点盲目”的情况处理得很好，罚分让他从赛道上的第11位提升到了第8位。
费尔南多·阿隆索的周末难以评判，因为资格赛和比赛的故障都缩短了他的表现，所以总的来说，他很难被放在其他位置，尽管他的速度看起来足够强，如果有机会的话本可以爬得更高。
兰多·诺里斯在复杂的麦克拉伦上无法重复他在Q2的表现，在Q3中最终并没有像他本可以做到的那样在发车线上取得更高的位置。他也许在比赛的最后阶段可以追上勒克莱尔，这意味着他将麦克拉伦带回了一个不错的位置，但并没有像可能的那样高。
威廉姆斯车队的阿尔本在有限的机械中不可避免地遇到了困难。队友卡洛斯·塞恩斯在资格赛中表现更好，尽管阿尔本认为他的最后一圈是本赛季最好的之一，一旦考虑到交通导致他在起步时失去了重要的涡轮速度，并且在比赛中也略占优势。然而，最终在Hirakawa那里失去的位置最终让他失去了一分。
虽然阿维德·林德布拉德在第一弯道刹车时的晚些时候的移动导致了与奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的碰撞，从而导致了他的退赛，但最终裁判官认为麦克拉伦车手应对随后发生的碰撞负责。林德布拉德在Q2中表现出良好的速度，但感觉Q3是一个错过的机会。
伊萨克·哈迪尔对他的混乱的排位赛圈不满意，但仍然跑出了可敬的成绩。他在与拉塞尔接触后第一圈发生打滑后恢复得很好，尽管 stewards 将责任归咎于梅赛德斯车手，尽管哈迪尔在碰撞前在5号弯道并排行驶时可能应该留出一些预防空间。尽管运气不佳，直到因其他车手的处罚而获得第九名，他仍然表现不错。
萨因斯可能比阿尔本排位更高，但那场战斗因队友在圈中起步慢而受到影响，他在大部分时间里都跑得较慢。这种模式在一场艰难的比赛中继续，尽管最后他并没有落后太多。
瓦尔特里·博塔斯由于发车位置处罚，在排位赛中仅作为拖车使用，但似乎缺乏佩雷斯所拥有的优势。他在比赛中表现整洁，直到前左悬挂出现问题。
拉塞尔在Q3中跑出了出色的圈速，如果燃料负载合适，可能获得杆位。然而，他的周末在起跑时的部署问题中发生了转折，这不是他的错。然而，最终，在与哈迪尔战斗时，他应该更加实际，因为高额的处罚使他排名第六。如果起跑时有适当的动力输出，他可能成为胜利的竞争者，这在很多方面概括了他的赛季。
科拉平托在周五和周六的比赛中落后于加斯利，但他在第一圈的表现非常出色，这让他有机会在赛道上获得第八名的好成绩。然而，由于他没有在3号弯出口对单黄旗做出反应，导致他被罚了10秒，这让他所在的级别比原本的要低。这是一个小错误——不如加斯利犯的错误那么严重——但代价非常昂贵。
勒克莱尔的速度没有问题，他可能比汉密尔顿有轻微的优势。然而，问题始于排位赛，他可能因为最后一次轮胎准备不到位而失去了杆位。他在比赛中犯了两次错误，第一次是在4号弯，他晚刹车攻击外侧，最终为法拉利失去了比赛创造了条件。第二次错误可能更严重，他在重启时试图攻击队友，试图切入内侧，结果锁死轮胎，并在比赛中一直带着这个轮胎问题。
和阿隆索一样，斯特罗尔有限的机会来展示他的实力，但他也有机会在Q1中跑完全程，而他的队友却没有。尽管如此，他仍然比队友慢了0.164秒。
皮亚斯特里的潜在速度比看起来更好，他在Q2中表现糟糕后，在比赛中很好地恢复了状态。这种挣扎应该算在他头上，以及他与Lindblad的碰撞。虽然他可以合理地不满Lindblad在刹车时的晚移动，并认为这迫使他绕到外侧，但根据赛车规则，这最终使他处于危险之中，并因为处罚而失去了稳定的结果。
加斯利在周五和周六的表现不错，顺利地完成了资格赛，但随后在发车时因部署问题而落后。尽管他不得不提前进站，但他仍然表现良好，但因为没有尊重双闪黄旗而被罚分，这是一个粗心大意的错误，毁了周末并让他失去了好成绩。
胡肯伯格的周末被一次单独的错误彻底破坏。他在发车时被4号弯的折叠带绊住，在与劳森的竞争中撞到了贝尔曼。考虑到发车圈不可避免地会拥堵，这是一个可以理解但可以避免的错误，这破坏了一个本可以让他进入上半区的周末。
detailEn: It's the second week of Edd Straw's new tier list Formula 1 driver rankings format, as he takes a closer look at each driver's individual performance at the Mexican Grand Prix.
Considering nobody was flawless across the Mexico City weekend, who ended up in the coveted S tier? And whose mistakes tanked their rankings?

As usual, you can ask your questions about Edd's rankings by commenting on this post in The Race Members' Club - and have a crack at compiling your own Mexican GP tier list with our handy visual tool!

Max Verstappen raced with his usual incisive brilliance, showing strong pace and outstanding decision-making at the starts and in keeping Hamilton behind. On top of that, he was also central to Red Bull's recovery after a difficult Friday.

In many circumstances, the lock-up that ruined his last qualifying lap would have denied him a place in this tier, but the mitigating circumstances of traffic's contribution to that save him - even though the one-place grid penalty for Friday nonsense with Liam Lawson is also a small negative that in other circumstances might have bumped him to a lower tier.

Ryo Hirakawa's unique circumstances mean he has to be judged by what would normally be generous standards for the job he did after taking over Esteban Ocon's seat. He was flirting with reaching Q2 before hitting Alex Albon's turbulent air in the middle sector of his final Q1 run, meaning the gap to Bearman was exaggerated. He then drove a combative race, passing both the Williams drivers late on, for a well-deserved point once penalties were applied.

Liam Lawson recovered from setbacks to score points. He started from the pits but despite the red flag timing not helping him, he made steady progress then surged from 15th at the standing restart to take what was ultimately the midfield win after penalties were applied.

For Lewis Hamilton, this was a strong weekend save for his part in the Turn 4 moment where both drivers braked too late to make the corner. Had he avoided that, he would likely swap places with Verstappen. His first pole position since 2023 was also brilliantly-taken.

While Sergio Perez's race was compromised by a five-second penalty for speeding in the pits (by 0.2km/h), the team put that down to a sensor problem. But while Perez was a little disappointed by qualifying thanks to the set-up not being nailed, he raced superbly in the first stint before first losing time to a wheelgun problem then the later penalty.

Ollie Bearman's weekend was dealt a blow when he had to switch to the old ADUO1-spec Ferrari engine during practice. Despite that, he was rapid although a track limits violation meant he didn't maximise qualifying. He drove a decent race until he was rear-ended by Nico Hulkenberg through no fault of his own. In normal circumstances he'd have been ranked in a higher tier than his team-mate, but this ordering reflects the unusual situation Hirakawa was in.

While Kimi Antonelli clinched the world championship, he was under the weather both in terms of health and pace in qualifying and wasn't able to match George Russell. He drove a neat and tidy race, running long and only pitting just before the race was red-flagged, and earned the right to celebrate his title on the podium.

Gabriel Bortoleto was perhaps marginally the quicker Audi driver in terms of peak, but sitting out in FP1 and then problems in both FP2 and FP3 limited him to just three flying laps before qualifying. He then banged in the sixth-fastest Q1 lap, and dealt well with being "a bit blind" on set-up for race stints, with penalties turning 11th-on-the-road into eighth.

Fernando Alonso's weekend is difficult to judge given problems cut short both qualifying and the race, so on balance it's difficult to put him anywhere else other than the middle tier even though his pace looked strong enough to have climbed higher had he had a fair crack at it.

Lando Norris couldn't repeat his Q2 form in Q3 in the tricky-to-drive McLaren and ultimately was once again not as high up the grid as he could have been. He also perhaps could have picked off Leclerc in the final part of the race, meaning that he brought the McLaren home in a good position but not as high as it might have been.

Williams driver Albon inevitably struggled in the limited machinery. Team-mate Carlos Sainz had the better of qualifying, although Albon felt his final lap was one of the best of the season once you allow for traffic costing him all-important turbo speed when starting the lap, and had the edge in the race. However, the late position-loss to Hirakawa ultimately cost him a point.

While Arvid Lindblad had a hand in the clash with Oscar Piastri that led to his retirement thanks to his late move under braking into Turn 1, ultimately stewards held the McLaren driver responsible for the collision that followed. Lindblad showed good pace, especially in Q2, but felt Q3 was a missed opportunity.

Isack Hadjar wasn't happy with his messy qualifying lap, but still turned out a respectable laptime. He recovered well from his first-lap spin after contact with Russell, which stewards held the Mercedes driver responsible for although Hadjar should perhaps have left some precautionary space given they'd been side-by-side through Turn 5 before the clash at Turn 6. He raced decently despite luck not being on his side until he was rewarded with ninth by penalties for other drivers.

Sainz may have outqualified Albon, but that battle was swung by his team-mate's slow start to the lap thanks to traffic and he was slower for much of it. That pattern continued in a difficult race, although he wasn't far behind in the end.
Valtteri Bottas acted solely as a towing vehicle in qualifying given his grid penalty, but appeared to lack the edge Perez had. He had a tidy race until the front-left suspension let go.

Russell produced a superb Q3 lap that might have earned pole position with a suitable fuel load. However, his weekend turned on the deployment problem at the start, which was not his fault. Ultimately, though, he should have been more pragmatic when battling with Hadjar given the high tariff of a penalty that condemned him to finishing sixth. With proper power delivery at the start, he could have been a victory contender, which in many ways sums up his season.

Franco Colapinto was a step behind Pierre Gasly during Friday and Saturday, but a great first lap set him on a course to finishing a fine eighth on-the-road. However, his tier is lower than it would have been thanks to him not responding to the single yellow flag on the run out of Turn 3 that led to a 10-second penalty. A minor error - and not as egregious a one as Gasly's - but a very costly one.

Pace was not a problem for Charles Leclerc, who perhaps had a mild edge over Hamilton. However, the negatives started in qualifying, where he likely lost pole position to not nailing the tyre prep on his final run. He then made two errors in the race, the first at Turn 4 with his late-braking attack around the outside, which ultimately created the conditions for Ferrari to lose the race. The second mistake was arguably worse, in his desperation to attack his team-mate locking up at Turn 1 at the restart while trying to cut to the inside and suffering a flatspot he carried to the end of the race.
Like Alonso, Lance Stroll had limited opportunities to show what he could do, but he also had the chance to run throughout Q1, unlike his team-mate, and was still 0.164s slower.

Piastri's underlying pace was better than it looked and he recovered well in the race from a baffling Q2. That struggle has to count against him, as does the collision with Lindblad as while he can justifiably be unhappy with Lindblad's late move under braking and argue it forced him around the outside, it ultimately put him in harm's way given the racing guidelines and cost him a solid result thanks to the penalty.

Gasly had a good run through Friday and Saturday, qualifying decently but then losing ground to a deployment problem at the start. He raced well despite having to take an early pitstop, but getting himself a penalty for not respecting double-waved yellows was a careless error that ruined his weekend and cost a good result.

Hulkenberg's weekend was catastrophically undermined by a single mistake. He was caught out by the Turn 4 concertina at the restart while battling with Lawson and rear-ended Bearman. This was an understandable but avoidable error given the inevitable congestion on a restart lap, and undermined a weekend that otherwise would have put him in the top half.
keyPointsZh: 维斯塔潘在墨西哥大奖赛中表现出色，尽管遭遇锁死，但凭借出色的表现和决策，保持了领先。
里卡瓦瓦在接替奥康的位置后，尽管遭遇了一些困难，但仍然表现出色。
斯特劳在《The Race》成员俱乐部中邀请读者提问并尝试自己编制墨西哥大奖赛排名。
keyPointsEn: Max Verstappen showed his usual brilliance despite a lock-up that could have affected his ranking.
Ryo Hirakawa performed admirably after taking over Esteban Ocon's seat, despite some difficulties.
Edd Straw invites readers to ask questions about his rankings and try to compile their own tier list in The Race Members' Club.
